concerns.text: The plan pivots from the required experimental permeability data (FR‑001) to computed geometric transport proxies (surface area, pore volume) as the target variable (see research.md: “Critical mismatch – FR‑001 expects experimental permeability, but no verified source exists.” and “Resolution: Compute geometric transport proxies … serve as a target variable”). This violates FR‑016, which mandates that the target be a peer‑reviewed, publicly available experimental permeability dataset, not a derived quantity.
